name: facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/apis/inferencers/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.load_weights_to_model: load model weights and dataset metadata from a checkpoint file into an MMPose model
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.inputs_to_list: convert image paths, video files, directories, or numpy arrays into a list for batch inference
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.get_webcam_inputs: set up a webcam generator that yields frames from a camera device for real-time pose inference
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.visualize_predictions: visualize pose estimation predictions with configurable keypoints, bounding boxes, and output directory
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.finalize_video_processing: finalize video processing by releasing the video writer and saving frame predictions to a JSON file

facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_MMPoseInferencer_2D_pose: run the MMPoseInferencer class to perform 2D keypoint detection on images using a pretrained pose2d model
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_MMPoseInferencer_3D_pose: run the MMPoseInferencer class to perform 3D pose estimation by providing both pose2d and pose3d model configs
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.call_MMPoseInferencer_predict: call the MMPoseInferencer with inputs to get pose predictions and visualization results with optional batch processing
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.visualize_MMPoseInferencer_predictions: visualize pose estimation predictions using the visualize method with configurable radius, thickness, and keypoint threshold
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.preprocess_MMPoseInferencer_inputs: preprocess input images or video frames into a model-feedable format using the preprocess method with collate function

facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_pose2d_inference: run 2D pose estimation on images or videos using a pretrained MMPose model with optional human detection
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_pose2d_webcam: run real-time 2D pose estimation from a webcam feed with automatic visualization display enabled
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_pose2d_topdown: run top-down 2D pose estimation with an integrated MMDetection object detector for bounding boxes
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_pose2d_bottomup: run bottom-up 2D pose estimation on images without requiring a separate human detection model
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_pose2d_heatmap: run 2D pose estimation and visualize predicted heatmaps with mmpose or openpose skeleton style

facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.run_Pose3DInferencer: run the Pose3DInferencer on an image or video to estimate 3D human pose keypoints
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.create_Pose3DInferencer: create a Pose3DInferencer instance with a 3D pose model and optional 2D pose detection model
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.preprocess_Pose3DInferencer_preprocess_s: preprocess a single input image to extract 2D keypoints and prepare data for 3D pose lifting
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.forward_Pose3DInferencer_forward: perform a forward pass through the 3D pose model and post-process the lifted keypoints
facebookresearch_sapiens/pose/mmpose/api.visualize_Pose3DInferencer_visualize: visualize 3D pose estimation predictions on input images with optional bounding boxes and keypoints
